main_visual_task: A silent suspense game in a real morning bedroom: careful hands stop a rolling coffee bean, muffle a grinder and loose kettle lid, then let the coffee bloom; the sleeping woman may be reacting, but the film withholds certainty.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the established young Chinese woman around twenty-eight, dark shoulder-length hair, natural East Asian features, cream cotton sleep top; one man visible only as realistic five-fingered hands and light-blue rolled sleeves; one glass bean jar, hand grinder, gooseneck kettle, pour-over brewer and one unlabeled white ceramic cup
prompt_bible.environment_lock: the established quiet modern Chinese bedroom, white bedding, light wooden bedside table, sheer curtains, rain-fresh window, no other people
prompt_bible.material_lock: real skin pores, cotton weave, oily roasted beans, brushed metal kettle, ceramic glaze, coffee grounds, water and steam; physically plausible contact and gravity
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: one real hard sunrise source from upper left, cool ambient window fill; every shadow falls lower right
prompt_bible.palette_lock: morning gold, cream white, pale blue, warm wood and espresso brown
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm cinema camera, shallow depth of field, restrained handheld breathing only where requested, natural film grain and contrast
prompt_bible.screen_direction: all object risk travels left to right; woman remains on frame-right side across cuts
prompt_bible.audio_policy: no dialogue; amplified bean roll, suppressed grinding, almost-metal click, soft water and one natural breath; exact sound mix in post
